name: Ooze | Dab Tool
description:
There are so many different kinds of dabber out there, so we've taken the best aspects of our favorite ones to create the ultimate dab tool! Ooze dabbers are made from surgical stainless steel for strength and durability. We combine that with the non-stick, heat-resistant capabilities of silicone. Silicone tips cover both ends, one rounded and one pointed, for expert handling of any type of concentrate you want to work with!

This wholesale pack is an incredible value, and single dabbers make perfect add-ons for just about every kind of smoking product sale. Includes 30 assorted colors of steel silicone dabbers. 

Features:

Non-stick
Double-ended
Silicone Tips
Surgical Stainless Steel Body
Concentrate Handling Tool
